facts.fact: 她要求「抱我一下，就一秒」
facts.anchor: Can you hold me, like just for a second?

facts.fact: 他抱着她轻晃，把她送上床
facts.anchor: It’s going to be okay, Flour. We’re going to get you to bed, okay?

facts.fact: 她哭诉 Jem 之伤：所有人都会恨我——但我不喜欢他那样
facts.anchor: I hurt Jem. Everyone’s going to hate me.

facts.fact: 灯全灭的她：他想把太阳拽回来让她重新发光
facts.anchor: drag the sun down from wherever it’s hiding

facts.fact: 保密指令：别让任何人知道她在哪——他答「我当你的保镖」
facts.anchor: I’ll be your bodyguard if they find out.

facts.fact: Bailey 主动冲进暴风雨替她搬行李——That’s my boy
facts.anchor: he lowers his head and runs out into the rain.

facts.fact: 他在她房门外靠着门睡了一整夜
facts.anchor: Did you sleep here all night?

facts.fact: Bailey 临走留话：希望毯子够暖——六年碎掉的心第一次渗进柔软
facts.anchor: I hope the blanket kept you warm.
